Name: Vintage Interface V2 Tweaks 1.6
Author: ItsSilvery
Description:
Just added the tweak [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41689835]Nom0ri[/url] missed, and some personal recolour tweaks that changes the Cursors2 file for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface V2[/url].

I didn't made this into a content patcher file because it will cause conflicts,
so u will have to manually replace the png in asset folder of Vintage Interface V2.

Definitely check out the tweak made by Nom0ri
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754?tab=description ]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754?tab=description [/url]

Of course full credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34767255]ManaKirel[/url] for making the original art!

* Made a mistake on uploading the file (It is fixed now)
﻿as the newest version of VI2 uses "EditImage" instead of "Overlay", 
﻿This should only affected the cursors2 file, the MenuTiles file should work just fine
﻿Sorry for those that downloaded the files
